quotes.text: Learn how to use extended authorizations to capture online card payments up to 30 days after authorization.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: - [mode](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md#create_checkout_session-mode) is set to `payment` and [capture_method](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md#create_checkout_session-payment_intent_data-capture_method) is set to `manual` on the [CheckoutSession](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/.md).

However, we recommend that you rely on the [capture_before field](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object.md#charge_object-payment_method_details-card-capture_before) to confirm the validity window for any given payment because these rules can change without prior notice.
The validity window won’t change after the PaymentIntent is confirmed.
By default, an authorization for an online card payment is valid for 7 days for most card networks.

findings: November 7, 2026 base capture provides a purpose statement and three variant links only (new raw lines 5-15). The May 11, 2026 raw has hosted, embedded and advanced/Elements full instructions (old raw lines 8-605); diff lines 3-608 show collapse to an index, not a changed validity period, network rule, API, fee or eligibility.

The old guide's online hold is an authorization, not capture or settled funds. Most card networks default to seven days online versus two days Terminal; extended holds can reach up to 30 days depending on network/category (old raw lines 12-56, 184-228, 482-526). Checkout requires payment mode and manual capture, while advanced PaymentIntent requires capture_method:manual and confirmed uncaptured state (old raw lines 22, 194, 492, 538-560). Request if_available and inspect associated Charge card extended_authorization.status enabled/disabled and capture_before; the latter is the payment-specific deadline (old raw lines 99-166, 295-321, 540-589).

Current source describes dated network windows and status/deadline accurately in broad terms (source lines 13-49) but omits manual capture in its API and constraints sections (lines 37-49), despite all three old variants requiring it. Add that baseline prerequisite and November navigation provenance while preserving May network tables and 2023 changes as dated claims.

The hosted and embedded Checkout Session code snippets set payment mode and if_available but omit payment_intent_data.capture_method:manual (old raw lines 111-132, 264-287), contradicting explicit prerequisite prose (old raw lines 22, 194). Do not treat the snippets alone as proof of a working extended hold. The embedded return-page text equates Checkout Session complete with payment succeeded (old raw lines 427-458), while the same guide's PaymentIntent example is requires_capture with amount_received 0 (old raw lines 295-321); distinguish session completion/authorization from capture or settlement.

Visa non-travel category 0.08% fee and CIT, Japan, healthcare/bill/debt conditions; AmEx end-of-stay/rental capture; Mastercard exclusion of Maestro/Cirrus; Discover narrowed September 2023 categories; beta Diners/UnionPay windows all come only from May raw (old raw lines 28-56, 200-228, 498-526), not November index. The related concept mirrors those dated scopes (wiki/concepts/stripe-extended-authorization.md:14-44).

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/extended-authorization, the full November base capture says online card authorizations can be held for capture up to 30 days and links three web UI variants; it establishes no current network table or API details (new raw lines 5-15). The May guide describes an IC+ feature, card-network and merchant-category limits, payment-mode Checkout Sessions with manual capture, or an advanced manually captured confirmed PaymentIntent (old raw lines 12-56, 184-228, 482-560). Requesting if_available does not prove enablement: inspect the associated Charge's extended_authorization.status and capture_before timestamp, then capture before that payment-specific deadline (old raw lines 99-166, 295-321, 562-589). The authorization and requires_capture state are separate from capture, settlement and available funds. source-stripe-extended-authorization.md summarizes dated windows but omits the manual-capture prerequisite and needs November navigation provenance.
